newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends easier vs dlr at 187.85/90.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends easier vs dlr at 187.85/90.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended Monday trading slightly easier against the dollar and firmly on the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (bid), traders said.
The forint finished at 187.85/90 to the dollar compared with 187.65/70 at midday and 187.85/90 at the opening.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
